from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.functions import explode
from pyspark.sql.types import DateType
 
spark = SparkSession.builder.getOrCreate()
 
# Chargement du parquet
df = (
    spark.read
        .option("recursiveFileLookup", "true")
        .parquet("abfss://dlfs5clou-clean@dl5clou.dfs.core.windows.net/clean/")
)
 
# Ajout des colonnes temps
df = (
    df.withColumn("year", F.year("event_date"))
      .withColumn("month", F.month("event_date"))
      .withColumn("day", F.dayofmonth("event_date"))
      .withColumn("hour", F.hour("created_at"))
)
 
# ================================
# TABLE : USER STATS
# ================================
df_user_stats = (
    df.groupBy("account_id")
      .agg(
          F.count("*").alias("toots_count"),
          F.avg("content_length").alias("avg_length"),
          (F.sum(F.size(F.split("content_clean", "#")) - 1)).alias("hashtag_count"),
          F.countDistinct("event_date").alias("active_days"),
          F.min("created_at").alias("first_toot"),
          F.max("created_at").alias("last_toot"),
          F.expr("percentile_approx(hour, 0.5)").alias("median_active_hour")
      )
      .orderBy(F.desc("toots_count"))
)
 
df_user_stats.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").saveAsTable("Database1.user_stats")
 
 
# ================================
# TOOTS PAR HEURE
# ================================
df_toots_by_hour = (
    df.groupBy("year", "month", "day", "hour")
      .agg(F.count("*").alias("total_toots"))
)
df_toots_by_hour.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").saveAsTable("Database1.toots_by_hour")
 
 
# ================================
# TOOTS PAR JOUR DE LA SEMAINE
# ================================
df_toots_weekday = (
    df.withColumn("weekday", F.date_format("event_date", "E"))
      .groupBy("weekday")
      .agg(F.count("*").alias("total_toots"))
)
df_toots_weekday.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").saveAsTable("Database1.toots_by_weekday")
 
 
# ================================
# TABLE HASHTAGS TRENDING
# ================================
df_hashtags = (
    df.withColumn("hashtags_raw",
                  F.regexp_replace(F.col("content_clean"), "[^#A-Za-z0-9_]", " "))
      .withColumn("hashtags", F.split("hashtags_raw", " "))
      .withColumn("hashtag", F.explode("hashtags"))
      .filter(F.col("hashtag").like("#%"))
      .groupBy("hashtag")
      .agg(F.count("*").alias("count"))
      .orderBy(F.desc("count"))
)
 
df_hashtags.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").saveAsTable("Database1.trending_hashtags")
 
 
# ================================
# TABLE WORD FREQUENCY
# ================================
df_words = (
    df.withColumn("words", F.split("content_clean", " "))
      .withColumn("word", F.explode("words"))
      .filter(F.length("word") > 3)
      .groupBy("word")
      .agg(F.count("*").alias("count"))
)
 
df_words.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").saveAsTable("Database1.word_frequency")
 
 
# ================================
# USER ACTIVITY CALENDAR
# ================================
df_user_calendar = (
    df.groupBy("account_id", "event_date")
      .agg(F.count("*").alias("toots"))
)
 
df_user_calendar.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").saveAsTable("Database1.user_calendar")
 
 
# ================================
# GENERATION DE LA TABLE CALENDRIER
# ================================
start = df.agg(F.min("event_date")).first()[0]
end = df.agg(F.max("event_date")).first()[0]
 
df_calendar = (
    spark.range(0, (end - start).days + 1)
        .withColumn("date", (F.lit(start) + F.col("id").cast("int")).cast(DateType()))
        .drop("id")
        .withColumn("year", F.year("date"))
        .withColumn("month", F.month("date"))
        .withColumn("day", F.dayofmonth("date"))
        .withColumn("weekday_number", F.dayofweek("date"))
        .withColumn("weekday_name", F.date_format("date", "EEEE"))
        .withColumn("week_of_year", F.weekofyear("date"))
)
 
df_calendar.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").saveAsTable("Database1.dim_calendar")
 
 
# ================================
# TABLE TOOTS DAILY
# ================================
df_toots_daily = (
    df.groupBy("event_date", "year", "month", "day")
      .agg(
          F.count("*").alias("total_toots"),
          F.countDistinct("account_id").alias("active_users"),
          F.avg("content_length").alias("avg_length")
      )
)
 
df_toots_daily.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").saveAsTable("Database1.toots_daily")
